title: Component trees per page: what PR #6 changed
subtitle: AShatsila/frontend-app-authoring PR #6 "feat: scope competency associations to the listed courses (#683)", head aa5b441.

pages.title: Page: CompetencyManagementPage
pages.sub: Route /taxonomy/:taxonomyId/competencies (src/index.jsx). Components follow the JSX nesting; grey text lines are changed non-React modules, listed under the component that calls them.

nodes.name: CompetencyManagementPage
notes: Unchanged. Renders CompetencyAssociationsPanel inside the page layout.

nodes.name: CompetencyAssociationsPanel
notes: Unchanged. Mounts the tree and, once a competency is selected, the provider + course pane.

nodes.name: CompetencyAssociationsProvider
notes: Context provider in CompetencyAssociationsContext.tsx. Associations are now scoped to the courses currently listed.
New notifyCoursesDisplayed(keys) / displayedCourseKeys: the course list reports its keys, and the criteria-groups query runs with them (disabled until the first report).
New isLoadingAssociations (groups or profile query pending) and isCourseAccessResolved (every course outline fetch settled).
associatedObjectIds (duplicate guard and 'already associated' marking) now covers listed courses only.
When the listed courses change, an unsaved placeholder row is discarded; post-delete focus reads the course-scoped cache entry.

nodes.name: data/apiHooks.ts
notes: Criteria-groups query is keyed by the listed course keys and skipped (skipToken) until they are reported.
New refreshCompetencyCriteriaGroups: after every write (create, operator, rule score, delete) it drops inactive cached pages and refetches the active one.

nodes.name: data/api.ts
notes: getCompetencyCriteriaGroups(tagId, courseKeys) always sends course_keys (comma-joined; empty means instance-wide only).

nodes.name: data/types.ts
notes: New CompetencyCriteriaTree (groups + criteria). CompetencyCriteriaGroupsResponse extends it with criteriaCount and totalCriteriaCount.

nodes.name: utils.ts
notes: buildCompetencyCriteriaGroupsIndex and associatedObjectIds retyped to take CompetencyCriteriaTree. No logic change.

nodes.name: CourseSearchBrowse
notes: Reports the listed course keys to the provider via notifyCoursesDisplayed in an effect.
Runs a second courses query (pageSize 1) to get the total accessible-course count.
Renders the new CourseListSummary under the toolbar, only once both counts are known and the association data matches the listed page (no stale numbers).
Passes courseListStatus to CriteriaAssociationsSection.

nodes.name: CourseSearchBrowse.scss
notes: Summary line gets overflow-wrap: anywhere.

nodes.name: CourseListSummary
notes: NEW component: the summary line under the search field.
Shows 'N of M courses' plus 'A of B criteria associations' (in the listed courses vs. all courses).
Six message variants for search term / start date / end date combinations. Search term truncated at 50 characters; dates shown as MM-DD-YYYY.

nodes.name: course-search/messages.ts
notes: Six new courses-summary messages, one per filter combination.

nodes.name: CriteriaAssociationsSection
notes: New required prop courseListStatus ('pending' | 'error' | 'success').
Shows a small spinner while the course list loads and renders CourseGroupList only on success, since groups are scoped to the listed courses.

nodes.name: CourseGroupList
notes: Loading check uses isPending instead of isLoading, because the scoped query starts disabled.
New spinner while the visible group list is empty but isCourseAccessResolved is false, so 'not known yet' no longer renders as the empty state.
Empty state now means 'none in the listed courses'. Empty-state focus effect also depends on isCourseAccessResolved.

nodes.name: RuleBox
notes: Group/rule components are unchanged; only their tests got the new response fields (criteriaCount, totalCriteriaCount).

nodes.name: CourseOutlineSubtree
notes: SubsectionRow's 'associate' button is also disabled while isLoadingAssociations, so a click cannot land before the groups and default profile have loaded.

otherPages.heading: Other pages that use this PR's changed components or modules: none
lines: Checked by searching src/ for imports of taxonomy/competency-management, CompetencyAssociationsContext, the course-search and criteria-groups barrels, and the competency data hooks.

The only consumers outside the folder are src/taxonomy/index.ts and src/index.jsx, which mount CompetencyManagementPage at /taxonomy/:taxonomyId/competencies. data/api.ts, data/apiHooks.ts, data/types.ts and utils.ts are imported only inside the folder.
If another page starts reusing these, it gets its own section here.

footnotes: Not drawn: test-only changes (*.test.tsx, testHelpers.tsx); shared widgets (Pagination, AlertMessage, LoadingSpinner, Helmet, Breadcrumb, SubHeader); competency-tree internals below CompetencyTreeItem. None of these changed in source.

Components such as CourseGroupSection, RuleBoxList and RuleBox also import utils.ts and data/types.ts, but only exports this PR did not touch, so those modules are listed once, under the provider that uses the changed ones.
